title: Sprint Change Proposal
description: Structured proposal for course correction during an active sprint or development cycle.

trigger.description: Classification of what triggered the course correction.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the course correction is needed.

impact.description: Assessment of the downstream impact caused by the trigger.

tasksAffected.description: List of task IDs or task names affected by this change.

riskLevel.description: Overall risk level of proceeding with or without the correction.

effortDelta.description: Estimated change in effort in story points or hours. Positive = more work, negative = less work.

summary.description: Optional one-paragraph summary of the impact.

proposedChanges.description: List of specific changes to apply to the current plan.

action.description: The type of change to apply to the target task or feature.

target.description: Task ID or feature name being changed.

rationale.description: One-sentence justification for this specific change.

deferredTo.description: If action is 'defer', the target sprint or milestone.

newPriority.description: If action is 'reprioritize', the new priority level.

approvedBy.description: Identifier of the stakeholder or user who approved this change proposal.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the proposal was created or approved.
